newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk poultry processor Banvit to raise output 25 pct in '97.
newsitem.headline: Turk poultry processor Banvit to raise output 25 pct in '97.

text.p: Turkish chicken meat, egg and feed producer Banvit Bandirma Vitaminli Yem Sanayii Ticaret A.S. is targeting an increase in production of over 25 percent in 1997 to more than 50,000 tonnes, a senior company official said .
"Our 1996 production will be slightly over 40,000 tonnes, more than last year's 29,350 tonnes. Next year, we will exceed 50,000 tonnes," Vural Gorener, general manager of the company, told Reuters.
Gorener said turnover was estimated at around seven trillion lira in 1996, double 1995's 3.53 trillion lira, and an increase parallel to the inflation rate was expected in 1997.

The poultry firm reported a 5.18 trillion lira turnover in the first nine months of this year, up 124 percent from the 2.31 trillion lira in the same 1995 period. Its nine-month output was 30,500 tonnes.
But its net profits fell to 122 billion lira in January-September from 274 billion in the same 1995 period.
"Because of the stiff competition in the Turkish market, the price increases remained below the inflation rate this year," Gorener said to describe the profit shrinkage.
Banvit shares which are traded on the Istanbul Stock Exchange's regional market, jumped to 25,750 lira in the second session from 23,250 at midday and 21,500 at Monday's close.
The company increased its chicken meat production capacity to 14,000 per day from 6,000 units, with an investment of $4.5 million.
Banvit also finished a $2 million investment to modernize its chicken meat processing plants this year, which will help the company to introduce new products.
Gorener said the competition would be tougher next year when two new producers in western Manisa and Bolu towns join in.
"Our capacity expansion and modernisation investments are to increase productivity and have easy access to new products, to be a step ahead among competitors," he added.
Currently Banvit is the second biggest chicken meat producer in Turkey, with 29,350 tonnes of output last year, after Koy-Tur's 70,000 tonnes.

The third biggest company is Mudurnu Tavukculuk A.S. with 20,000 tonnes of production in 1995 while several other firms shared the remaining 180,000 tonnes of the rapidly growing market which reached 300,000 tonnes last year.
Banvit also produced 150,490 tonnes of feed and 30 million eggs in 1995.
